scope.supplemental_ROI: whole native modeled XY cross-section, depth15..20mm; separately reported
scope.coordinates: x,y horizontal; z positive depth from top, all positions mm
scope.weights: saved fractional primary ROI and h^2 dz native full-cell volume; exact face-clipped slab
scope.whole_XY_geometry: center-in-disk FVM square cells; staircase wall, not exact cylinder clipping; no volume renormalization
scope.quantiles: stable inverse volume-weighted ECDF, searchsorted side=left; native cell steps/ties retained; no interpolation

metrics.maxTIS: fundamentals only, maximum over2074 sampled directions; lower bound to continuous direction maximum
metrics.RMS: total vector electric-field RMS including all4 stored square_3h spectral lines; not modulation

scope.omitted: X/Y/Z directional scalar fields not cached; sine/triangle RMS not available in this archive
scope.current_sum: sum of each physical output RMS including all harmonics/passive-frequency currents; bookkeeping, not common-GND return current
scope.skin_contact_only: eight skin/contact burden caps, no source-power cap and no1Vpp ceiling; may exceed1Vpp numerically
scope.legacy_composite_full_skin: same eight caps plus source-power cap and1Vpp ceiling
scope.equal_current_and_power: no1Vpp ceiling; only named denominator is equalized
scope.limits: frozen raw same-grid baseline numerical burdens and scalar cutoffs; not human safety/activation limits

preregistration.native_hash_scope: all plan input_sha256 plus consumed native grid/metadata; unused field/potential bytes not read
